_comment: Copy to config/resume_rules.json. Drives scripts/verify_resume.py. Set during onboarding.
_candidate_name_note: First word(s) the compiled PDF must start with - the QA gate checks the name is the first thing on the page. Case-insensitive. Replace 'JANE' with your own name during onboarding. Use enough of the name to be unambiguous.
_density_note: Calibrated for the shipped template (Calibri, ~9.8pt). Below ~600 words the page reads visibly thin. Do not lower these to make a thin resume pass - add a real bullet instead.
required_facts: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt \(Issuing Body\)
_required_facts_note: Regexes for text that MUST appear in every resume - typically a certification with its correct issuer. Replace the example with your own, or leave empty [].
_banned_facts_note: Regexes for WRONG facts that must never appear - e.g. a certification you once had misattributed on a draft. Leave empty [] if none.
_banned_title_claims_note: Regexes tested against the FIRST sentence of the summary. List any job title you have never actually held so the summary cannot claim it. Leave empty [] if you are fine claiming your target titles.
